backstory.v: He acquired an extra grip and now finds ordinary things alarmingly delicate. His brass hand was installed to improve the handling of everything the building considers simple. Residents are either upgraded or falling behind. A dissonant card has made him value the care with which his ordinary goo hand steadies a neighbour's cup. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Griff wurde verbessert. Die Dinge verhalten sich weiterhin empfindlich.

backstory.v: She remembers every update except the one that was meant to improve her mood. The punched roll preserves every update except the reason the previous version needed replacing. HyperNorm classifies memories as current or inconvenient. An ambiguous card has persuaded her to keep an old kindness that the latest procedure does not recognise. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Versionsstand ist bekannt. Eine Verbesserung wurde daraus nicht automatisch abgeleitet.

backstory.v: He has excellent capacity and no intention of spending it on this meeting. His small service hatch has made the residents' committee unusually interested in his available capacity. People are either charged or uncooperative. A dissonant card has taught him to reserve enough energy for a friend rather than spend it all proving readiness. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Kapazität ist vorhanden. Eine Verwendung muss deshalb nicht sofort erfolgen.

backstory.v: She can detect almost anything except whether she is expected to enjoy it. The brass ring and scanner detect more than the building has categories for. HyperNorm calls readings valid or faulty according to whether they agree. A contradictory card has made her trust a worried neighbour's account even when the dial remains perfectly calm. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Sensor funktioniert. Seine Bewertung der Situation wurde nicht bestellt.

backstory.v: He is powered by a reserve of determination somebody forgot how to switch off. His winding key supplies determination that the association keeps mistaking for unlimited availability. Residents are either active or unnecessary. An ambiguous card has persuaded him to sit with a tired neighbour without turning the pause into another task. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Der Antrieb läuft. Eine Feierabendfunktion ist nicht dokumentiert.

backstory.v: He maintains the upgrades by keeping the original faults in excellent condition. The elbow brace supports a maintenance routine that preserves more personality than the upgrade committee intended. HyperNorm sorts faults into repaired or unacceptable. A dissonant card has made him leave one harmless imperfection alone, beginning with his own. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Fehler sind gepflegt. Ein Austausch würde den Charakter gefährden.
